paragraph.title: Section
paragraph.splitHint: To split at a line: right-click the lyric block on the timeline, or drag the boundary between two sections on the section track.
paragraph.energyHint: When auto, the pack decides from the section type and word count; when manual, it decides how quiet or loud the candidate compositions are.
paragraph.lastNoTransition: The last section has no exit transition.

shot.title: Shot
shot.bridge: Instrumental bridge: no lyrics, composition only.
shot.componentsHint: The composition is the style itself; typography and accent can be replaced separately and only affect this shot.
shot.borrowedHint: The text is set by {{text}} inside this composition's text area (dashed box in the preview); composition and accent are still {{host}}'s.
shot.pickerHint: Hover a thumbnail to preview it, click to replace; arrow keys + Enter work too.
shot.pickerMixing: A style from another pack draws this cell with that pack; shot boundaries stay the same.
shot.pickerNoMixing: To switch to another pack's style, turn on shot mixing in the arrangement settings of the inspector.

line.title: Lyric line
line.translationHint: The translation shown as subtitle; clear it to hide the subtitle for this line.
line.staleSegmentation: After the text edit, this line's manual segmentation no longer matches the new text (automatic segmentation is used for now).
line.segmentsHint: Segmentation only affects type hierarchy and shots, never the text.
line.segmentsInvalid: Joined together it must match the original text exactly.

project.mixByKindHint: Sections set individually in the inspector are not affected.
project.shotMixing: Mix packs shot by shot within a section
project.hint: Click a section, shot or lyric line on the timeline to edit it.

selectionGone: The selected item no longer exists after re-arranging.

picker.label: Style
picker.hover: {{kind}} ({{mood}}) — hover to preview, click to replace

library.pickHint: Hover to preview, click to give the selected shot this style
library.pickShot: Click a card to give the selected shot that style.
library.otherPack: The selected shot belongs to another pack; turn on shot mixing to switch it to another pack's style.
library.hint: Favorite styles are picked automatically more often; blocked styles are never picked automatically.
